title: Azusawa Kohane — Our Last Practice〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't know when I'll get to see him again next, so I need to show him how much I've improved with his help!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, since this is our last practice...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Just show me what you've got, plain and simple. Sing with everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Only Taiga's here to listen, but I'll sing like I did at Crawl Green and...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You said that you wanted to get better. Do you still feel the same way?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
I still want to get better at singing!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, wanna give it a try with me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He's taught me so much, and I want him to hear how I sound now...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
H-How did I do...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
It made me think about...STAY GOLDEN, was it?
You sang like there was no tomorrow that time.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You've definitely improved even more since then.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But from where I'm standing, you've still got a lot of work to do.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
So, try singing that again for me.
Since this is our last practice together, I'll be as detailed as I can with my criticism.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright, it's nearly dusk, so let's call things here...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Ah, lemme stop you there.
I don't want to see any waterworks from you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: This isn't the last you'll be seeing of me, so just act the way you normally do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you for everything you've done for me!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: By the way, is your team free to meet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, about that. The others said they should all be available tomorrow afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sorry for asking you all on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
They all mentioned how they wanted to see you one last time before you returned to the US.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But at the same time... They were wondering why you asked us all to meet with you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Well, I also wanna see you one last time. I'll explain more tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Again, thank you for going out of your way to teach me all these things!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, a message...
It's from An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... Oh, Shinonome and the others are at her place already.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll let her know that we just finished practicing and that I'm heading over now.
